release: Komorebi Physics Lean v0.38.0 — Checked Block 38

claims.statement: The fair-bit binary CDF equals x on the closed unit interval.
Binary positional decoding is measure preserving from fair streams to normalized Lebesgue measure on the closed unit interval.
Transposing time-major three-bit vectors gives three independent fair streams and preserves product measure.
Three-coordinate binary decoding pushes the bit-cube product measure to product volume on the closed unit cube.
The octree decoder pushes octree product measure to cube volume.
Pullback along the octree decoder is an L2 linear isometry.
The octree and Euclidean cube L2 spaces are already proved unitarily equivalent.
claims.reason: An almost-everywhere inverse or surjectivity of the pullback has not been formalized.

claims.statement: Concrete Euclidean dyadic step-spinor spaces are dense.
